name: DCWP Language Line Interpretation Services
description:
This dataset records individual calls made to the New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection's language line interpretation service. Each row represents one interpreted call and includes the date and time of the call, the language requested (36 languages appear, including Spanish, Mandarin, and Cantonese), an access code identifying the requesting unit or program (such as Intake, Licensing, Collections, Paid Sick Leave, or Adjudication), and the call duration in seconds. The sample covers 5,000 calls with no missing values in any column.

The data can be used to analyze demand for interpretation services by language and by program area, identify peak call periods for staffing and scheduling, and estimate service volume and cost through call duration. It also supports evaluation of compliance with municipal language access requirements for limited-English-proficient residents and comparison of interpretation needs across agency functions.
